title: Commercial Solutions for Classified Multi-Site Connectivity Capability Package
coordinate_system: PDF points, origin top-left; page numbers are one-based physical PDF pages.
normalization: Replace each run of Unicode whitespace with one ASCII space and trim only leading/trailing whitespace. Preserve case, punctuation, hyphens and all other characters. Raw extracted strings and char coordinates are retained.
sentence_rule: Every literal U+002E period ends a prose sentence and is retained. No abbreviation, decimal, URL, or linguistic exceptions. Typed headings, labels, table cells and front matter are outside prose scope. Prose in captions and footnotes is in scope. Trailing text without a period is separately typed.
table_rule: One record per logical data row. Repeated physical headers are separate source occurrences. Continuation rows across pages are joined with original fragments and locations retained. Header/title/note references contextualize rows.
image_label_method: 131 manual visual transcriptions; raw OCR retained separately; figure-level boxes and relative label positions.
